resources.string: Something on this phone stopped FERB from opening. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart the phone.
This app controls your Mac, so it opens only with your fingerprint, face or PIN. This phone has no screen lock. Set one in Android\'s settings, then come back.

On your Mac, FERB shows the code under the picture. Type or paste it here.
FERB uses the camera only to read the code on your Mac. Nothing is recorded.
The camera is off for FERB. You can type the code instead.

FERB needs to be open on your Mac. In FERB, open Settings, then Phone, and choose Pair a phone. Scan the code it shows, or type it here. Both screens then show the same six digits: say yes on your Mac only if they match.
Your Mac can\'t be reached. What you send waits here until it\'s back.

Cancelled here. Your Mac may have got it already; if so, it shows in the chat.

This answer needs your fingerprint, and this phone\'s fingerprint key changed. Answer on your Mac, or pair this phone again.
This isn\'t connected on the phone yet. It comes in an update of FERB. Until then, use it on your Mac.
Browsing and sending files comes in an update of FERB.
Not on the shared relay. This waits until your phone reaches your Mac directly or through your own relay.
Nothing yet. What you ask FERB to do shows here.
Your phone uses %1$s when it can\'t reach your Mac directly. It is set in FERB on your Mac, in Settings, Phone.

Without your own relay, your phone uses the free shared relay when it can\'t reach your Mac directly. Your own relay carries everything at full speed: FERB on your Mac shows how to set one up, in Settings, Phone.
Your relay can\'t be reached; the public relay is used until it is back.
FERB on your Mac is older than this app. Update FERB on your Mac to use everything here.

This phone stops using FERB on your Mac. The chat kept here is deleted. Your Mac keeps everything; to use it here again, pair this phone again.
With Stay connected on, FERB tells you on this phone when it needs an answer or finishes something. Android asks whether FERB may show notifications.
Notifications are off for FERB, so nothing can tell you. You can turn them on in Android\'s settings.
